browserScope: Two cores and three desktop engines per format; Windows WebKit is not Safari hardware. Kept original assertions, 20s timeout and zero retries. No long-load acceptance is inferred.

failedSource.reason: WebKit elapsed time primarily before plugin installation; trace distinguishes client/browserside delay. Both failures remain failures.

manualBrowser.mode: normal yarn dev docs example, local media and XML
manualBrowser.limitation: Development smoke only. Browser.getVersion unsupported; userAgent read through supported CDP. Earlier stale tab focus timeout retained in change record.
